cards.title: Icons: pick a style
cards.text: The same 20 icons drawn three ways. Pick the style; the full set of about 245 then follows in it.
cards.why: My pick is A: it is the one that looks like the game's own sprites, every ability gets its own object, and it still reads on the hero card at 24 px. B is the clearest when tiny but plainer. C is the richest large and the muddiest small.
cards.details:
Each sheet shows the ten abilities, four trinkets and six stats large, then ready, on cooldown and locked for two of them. The next three cards have every icon by itself, and the style at the size the game really shows it.

Nothing in the game has changed: today's icons stay until you pick.

items.label: A · Painted emblem
items.text: The sprite style in a tile: the object itself, outlined and shaded. Rim = role or rarity.

items.label: B · Bold glyph
items.text: Two tones: one cream shape on a tile in the role colour. The clearest at the smallest size.

items.label: C · Scene medallion
items.text: A round window onto the ability happening. Backdrop = element, ring = role and timer.

cards.title: Style A · Painted emblem
cards.text: The sprite style in a tile: the object itself, outlined and shaded. Rim = role or rarity. Tick what works; com
cards.why: Each icon is its own item, large and at the sizes the game would show it. The ones I left unticked are the ones I would redraw first in this style.

items.label: At real size on the phone
items.text: The Archer's card in a fight beside today's, a stat row, ability rows at 40 px, trinkets at 36 px.

items.label: Shield Bash
items.text: Paladin. Today it shares the shield with nine other abilities.

items.label: Barrage
items.text: Archer. Three arrows loosed as a fan.

items.label: Frost Arrow
items.text: Archer. Today a plain snowflake, shared with Ice Shard and Frost Nova.

items.label: Roll
items.text: Archer, the movement skill. Today the dash arrow, shared with eight others.

items.label: Whirl
items.text: Berserker. The flail going round. Today the same swirl as Cleave and Reap.

items.label: Chain Lightning
items.text: Storm Mage. Today all three of her abilities are the same bolt.

items.label: Sanctuary
items.text: Cleric, the heal. Today the same sun as Smite and Consecrate.

items.label: Raise Dead
items.text: Necromancer, a summon. Today the same skull as Bone Spear.

items.label: Backstab
items.text: Twinfang. Today the same dagger as Fan of Knives.

items.label: Call Wolf
items.text: Druid, a summon. Today a paw.

items.label: Vampire Tooth
items.text: Common. Today it is nearly the same picture as the Venom Fang.

items.label: Hook and Chain
items.text: Rare. Today too thin to read at 18 px.

items.label: Whirling Knives
items.text: Epic. Today a busy tangle at 18 px.

items.label: Phoenix Feather
items.text: Legendary.

items.label: Damage
items.text: Your example: a sword beside the number.

items.label: Health
items.text: A red heart (green stays the colour of healing).

items.label: Armour
items.text: A shield.

items.label: Attack speed
items.text: A sword with speed streaks; yellow, so it never reads as Damage.

items.label: Move speed
items.text: A boot with the same streaks.

items.label: Range
items.text: A drawn bow.

cards.title: Stats beside a number
cards.text: Your stat line (a sword and a number, and the rest) in each style, at 14 and 16 px.
cards.why: The stats can follow a different style from the abilities. A is painted like the sprites; B is one flat colour per stat and the crispest at 14 px; C is a white mark on a coloured chip.

items.label: A · Painted emblem
items.text: Six of the nine hero stats; ability haste, healing and potency would follow.
